title: 时态呼应

examples.en: He says (that) he is busy now.
He said (that) he was busy then.
The teacher told us the earth moves around the sun.
examples.zh: 老师告诉我们地球绕着太阳转。

guess.question: “他说他明天会来”，英文该怎么说？

options.text: He said (that) he would come the next day.
options.feedback: 对！主句是过去时，从句也要退成相应的过去时态（will → would）。

options.text: He said (that) he will come tomorrow.
options.feedback: 不对——主句 said 是过去时，从句的 will 要退成 would。
不对——现在时和 tomorrow 矛盾，也没有体现“退时态”。

rule.rule: 主句是现在时，从句按需要用任何时态；主句是过去时，从句要退成相应的过去时态；从句说的是客观真理时，永远用一般现在时
rule.formula: ① 主现从任：He says he is / was / will be busy.　② 主过从过：is/am → was；will → would；do → did；have done → had done　③ 真理永现：The teacher said the earth moves around the sun.

anchors.en: He said that he was doing his homework at that time.
anchors.zh: 他说他那时正在做作业。
anchors.note: 现在进行时 → 过去进行时

anchors.en: Our teacher told us that light travels faster than sound.
anchors.zh: 老师告诉我们光比声音传播得快。
anchors.note: 客观真理用一般现在时

trap.wrong: He said he will come tomorrow.
trap.right: He said he would come the next day.
trap.why: 主句是过去时，从句的 will 要退成 would，tomorrow 也要变成 the next day。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——主过从过要“退一格”，只有客观真理例外，永远用现在时。

check.stem: He said that he ____ his homework at that time.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，从句要退成过去进行时
主句是过去时，不能用将来时
与 at that time 不符

check.stem: The teacher told us that the moon ____ around the earth.

options.distractor: 客观真理永远用一般现在时
客观真理用一般现在时

check.explanation: 客观真理 → moves（一般现在时）。

options.text: He said he had finished the work.
He said he has finished the work.
options.distractor: 主句是过去时，要用 had finished

options.text: He said he have finished the work.
options.distractor: 主谓不一致，时态也不对

options.text: He said he will finish the work.

check.explanation: 主过从过：现在完成时 → 过去完成时 had finished。
